context_read: Glob2Activity.setPreparingAssets shows an indeterminate progress spinner and centeredTextView while native startup prepares assets; this is an ongoing process status, not a menu heading or imperative.
disposition: Improve terse Google nounphrase to explicit natural ongoing status.
reason: खेळाची correctly marks preparation of the game; तयारी सुरू आहे explicitly says preparation is underway. Respectful instruction morphology is not needed for a status. Retain U+2026 ellipsis and avoid suggesting the game is already ready.
